gate_1_no_program_changed.claim: routing the renderer's raw operations through mime.core.switch (no context open) changes no program a step, a run or its forward-mode derivative compiles: the compiled text, source locations removed, is the same as #297's head's
gate_1_no_program_changed.case: probe/hlo.py through .github/probe/bit_compare.py, base 82219938bbb7016679c3f52268b44b69fd32212b against this head; programs hlo_f64 and hlo_f32, each writing three arrays (step, run, jvp) of the compiled text

prediction.value: every array np.array_equal, six of six
prediction.why: a switch function with no context open traces exactly its operation (mime.core.switch), the lambdas that give an indicator and a resolution are evaluated only inside a collector, and the collector-only path of _box_coverage is not taken; the one place the traced order of operations could move, _edge_in_disc's chain and square_below's pieces, keeps its order

gate_1_no_program_changed.metric: the compiled module's text, which predicts bit-for-bit equality of a run's arrays better than the arrays of one input (every program it can run is the same)

control.plant: the camera's mount moved one ulp along y on the base side (hloulp_f64): a constant of the program, so the text must differ
control.environment_variable: none: the program name hloulp_f64 selects it in probe/hlo.py
control.expected_rate: 3/3 arrays differ, the comparison of the controls arm's base (HEAD's own worktree) with the head
control.clean_expected: the same program against itself (hlo_f64 in the controls arm) equal, 3/3
control.resolution: one ulp of a constant is the smallest change a program can carry

gate_1_no_program_changed.if_wrong: an array differs: find the first differing instruction (the text with locations stripped, by diff) and the site that moved it; a difference that is only an order of operations the compiler schedules is still a changed program and is fixed in the source
gate_1_no_program_changed.cannot_discriminate_if: both sides stripped to nothing (the text is checked non-empty: 1.6 to 2.3 million characters a program) or the base side ran the head's tree (the controls arm shows an ulp differs)

gate_2_durations_on_a_runner.claim: the two tests the review of #299 named run, cold and alone on a 4-vCPU runner, within the times the allowlist row will quote: the camera.corner harness row, and the camera's two guard points (now their own test, without the graph the other points' test builds)
gate_2_durations_on_a_runner.case: arms corner and cameras-points: python -m pytest <node id> -p no:cacheprovider --durations=0 --junitxml, one process each, cold caches, one job per arm

prediction.value: corner: 20 to 40 s call (11 to 13 s locally on this laptop at nice 10 for the classification, 15.6 s inside a run, 24.5 s alone with its setup by the reviewer; runner tests have run about twice the laptop's time); cameras-points: each of the two tests under 10 s
prediction.basis: measured-before-on-a-laptop, scaled by the runner/laptop ratio seen on the sensing tests (77 s against 35 to 44 s)
prediction.why: the row's time is tracing: each forced branch at each offset a fresh trace of the pixel's integration with its corner sub-samples unrolled under the collector

gate_2_durations_on_a_runner.metric: the call duration of the node id in the junit file, and the setup duration reported separately

control.plant: none: a measurement, not a detection
control.resolution: the junit file's seconds to the millisecond

gate_2_durations_on_a_runner.if_wrong: a corner call over 60 s: make the row faster (fewer offsets or a coarser secant) before listing it; the allowlist row quotes the measured time either way
gate_2_durations_on_a_runner.cannot_discriminate_if: the arm fails before the test runs (the junit file is empty)
